column2: Suggested corrections: how does the app help fix words misread by “✨ Read the record”?
column3: After reading, words that look like a known word are underlined in purple (uncertain words stay highlighted in yellow): “décembe” → “décembre”, “mil huit aut” → “cent”. Click a word: 1 to 3 suggestions, “Keep as is” or “Add to lexicon”. “✓ Accept the N safe suggestions” applies them at once and “↶ Undo” goes back: nothing changes without you. On the workshop text: “🪄 Corrections”. The lexicon: the words of records, those of “📖 Reading help”, and the surnames, first names, places and occupations in your database (without living people or confidential records); smaller for Latin and German. Settings → Handwriting recognition (HTR): “Suggest corrections” and the threshold.
